en: Okay, let's go over the plan one more{SAUT}time.{PAGE}We're looking for dinosaur bones left{SAUT}behind by the Ravenous Beast.{PAGE}If we can find a fresh set of bones, then{SAUT}it should be close by!
I'll be examining the bones, so that{SAUT}part's covered.
Yeah, looks like it. He says he's good at{SAUT}tracking.
No... It looks like he wants to help.
Huh, they do kinda look like they go{SAUT}together―like an investigator and a{SAUT}police dog!
Ahaha, you think so? Well then, I'm{SAUT}counting on you, Koromaru-kun.{PAGE}Do you think you can lead us to some{SAUT}bones right now?
It sounds like we should head east.
I see. That's a rather keen sense of smell.{SAUT}Shall we get going, then?
